create_Joystick_env: create a Joystick environment for Unitree G1 robot locomotion with configurable task and reward scales
create_default_config: create a default configuration dictionary for the Joystick G1 locomotion task with noise, reward, and push settings
test_sample_command: test the Joystick sample_command method that generates random linear and angular velocity commands
test_step_simulation: test the Joystick step method that advances simulation with motor targets, contact detection, and reward computation
test_get_observation: test the Joystick _get_obs method that builds noisy and privileged observations from simulation data
